corr-brand-titles.label: Correlation: 2026 brand value vs titles won
corr-brand-titles.dataset: Houlihan Lokey IPL Brand Valuation Study press releases (2025, 2026); CricField warehouse: matches (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
corr-brand-titles.query: SELECT m.season_id, m.winner_id FROM matches m WHERE m.date = (SELECT MAX(x.date) FROM matches x WHERE x.season_id = m.season_id)

validation.method: n = 10 franchises; descriptive only, no significance claimed

corr-brand-win2026.label: Correlation: 2026 brand value vs 2026 win rate
corr-brand-win2026.dataset: Houlihan Lokey IPL Brand Valuation Study press releases (2025, 2026); CricField warehouse: matches (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026)
corr-brand-win2026.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, COUNT(*) n FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (0) OR m.team2_id IN (0)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2026 AND 2026
